edges.reason: mintTo calls _getNextTokenId to derive the new token id.
mintTo calls _incrementTokenId after minting.
_getNextTokenId reads _currentTokenId and adds 1.
_incrementTokenId performs _currentTokenId++.
mintTo assigns the computed value to the newTokenId local.
mintTo mints the new token to the _to parameter.
mintTo is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
onlyOwner compares owner() against the caller using the stored _owner.
msg.sender is compared against the stored owner in onlyOwner.
setBaseTokenUri writes the caller-supplied string into _baseTokenUri.
setContractUri writes the caller-supplied string into _contractUri.
baseTokenURI reads _baseTokenUri.
contractURI reads _contractUri.
Constructor initializes the base token URI state.
Constructor initializes the contract URI state.
Constructor stores the proxy registry address.
Constructor calls _initializeEIP712 with the token name.
Constructor consumes the _proxyRegistryAddress parameter.
setBaseTokenUri consumes the baseTokenUri parameter.
setContractUri consumes the contractUri parameter.
setBaseTokenUri is gated by onlyOwner.
setContractUri is gated by onlyOwner.
isApprovedForAll reads proxyRegistryAddress to query the OpenSea proxy.
isApprovedForAll uses the owner parameter for the proxy lookup.
isApprovedForAll compares the operator parameter with the proxy address.
_msgSender returns msg.sender when not routed through the self-call.
executeMetaTransaction builds the local MetaTransaction struct.
executeMetaTransaction reads and increments the user's nonce.
executeMetaTransaction calls verify to validate the signature.
executeMetaTransaction uses the userAddress parameter as nonce key and from.
executeMetaTransaction forwards the functionSignature parameter into the self call.
executeMetaTransaction forwards sigR into verify.
executeMetaTransaction forwards sigS into verify.
executeMetaTransaction forwards sigV into verify.
executeMetaTransaction passes attacker-influenced calldata and userAddress to the low-level self call.
The low-level call re-enters this contract with appended userAddress, enabling callback-style reentrancy.
executeMetaTransaction stores the low-level call success and return data.
executeMetaTransaction uses msg.sender as the relayer address.
verify calls ecrecover on the typed message hash with user-supplied signature values.
verify calls hashMetaTransaction to build the message hash.
verify compares the recovered address to the signer parameter.
verify hashes the metaTx parameter contents.
_initializeEIP712 calls _setDomainSeperator.
_setDomainSeperator writes the computed hash to domainSeperator.
hashMetaTransaction reads nonce, from and functionSignature from metaTx.
